description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate small crop plants arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell, growth stages from left to right. Top row, wheat: 1 a tiny green sprout of two blades, 2 a small tuft of green wheat grass, 3 a tall clump of green wheat stalks, 4 a ripe golden wheat bundle with heavy grain ears ready to harvest. Bottom row, carrot: 1 a tiny pair of seed leaves, 2 a small bunch of feathery carrot leaves, 3 a bigger bunch of feathery leaves, 4 lush feathery carrot leaves with a bright orange carrot top showing at the base, ready to harvest. Each plant stands upright on a tiny dark soil mound, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural colors, every plant fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no field, no shadow, no text, no numbers
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
